about.headline: Electric driving, rooted in Ghana
about.body:
XPENG Ghana brings intelligent electric vehicles to customers across the country. From Accra test drives to ownership support in major cities, our team helps you choose the right model, understand charging, and stay confidently on the road.

We welcome families, executives, and fleet buyers who want a refined EV experience with local support — showrooms, service, and guidance that stays with you after delivery.

privacy.headline: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
XPENG Ghana respects your privacy. When you book a test drive, request a quote, or contact our team, we collect only the details needed to respond — such as your name, phone number, email, preferred city, and message.

We use this information to confirm appointments, share model information, and improve our customer experience. We do not sell your personal data. Access is limited to authorised staff and service partners who help fulfil your request.

You may ask us to update or delete your contact details by emailing hello@xpengghana.com. This policy may be updated as our services grow; the latest version will always appear on this page.

terms.headline: Terms of Use
terms.body:
By using the XPENG Ghana website, you agree to browse model information, showroom details, and forms for personal enquiry purposes only.

Vehicle specifications, pricing, colours, and availability shown on this site are illustrative and may change. Final offers are confirmed by XPENG Ghana in writing at the point of sale.

Content on this site — including text, imagery, and branding — belongs to XPENG Ghana or its licensors and may not be copied for commercial use without permission.

For sales, service, or ownership questions, contact our Accra Experience Centre or email hello@xpengghana.com.
